name: parcel-preact-typescript-boilerplate
description: simple parcel2 preact typescript project without preact-compat

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.rebuild:bun: bun run clean:bun && bun run build
scripts.rebuild:pnpm: pnpm run clean:pnpm && pnpm run build
scripts.clean: npm run clean:build && npm run clean:cache
scripts.clean:bun: bun run clean:build && bun run clean:cache
scripts.clean:pnpm: pnpm run clean:build && pnpm run clean:cache
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run test && npm run lint && npm run check
scripts.ci:bun: bun run build && bun run test && bun run lint && bun run check
scripts.ci:pnpm: pnpm run build && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint && pnpm run check

author: benevolar
browserslist: > 0.5%, last 2 versions, not IE 9-11, not dead
